title: neptunia pubescens var. microcarpa
intro: Neptunia pubescens var. microcarpa, commonly known as the ' Small-fruited Neptunia', is a plant species in the family Fabaceae, native to tropical regions of Asia and Australia. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, which include health benefits such as treating fever, rheumatism, and various gastrointestinal issues. The therapeutic actions of Neptunia pubescens var. microcarpa include anti-inflammatory, antipyretic, and antispasmodic activities, which can help alleviate pain and reduce inflammation. The bioactive constituents of this plant include alkaloids, glycosides, and other compounds that contribute to its medicinal properties.
